title.purpose: Card titles; the nav mark JG.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The single shadow level; cards and imagery only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action; ink authority, no lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f172a; color: #faf7fb; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on paper; stroke in Ledger Line, fill shifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #f9f9f9; color: #2d3435; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #dde4e5; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e4e4e7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Wash-filled tertiary action; darkens gently on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f4f4f5; color: #2d3435; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(244, 244, 245, 0.8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless control; fills with Ledger Wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #2d3435; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f2f4f4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Text action in ink; underline appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { background: none; border: none; color: #0f172a; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill tag for project tech stacks and skill badges.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #f4f4f5; color: #2d3435; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White project surface with Ledger Line edge and the single shadow level.
components.html:
Naturella

Loja especializada na fabricação de peças decorativas em concreto.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #2d3435; border: 1px solid #dde4e5; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #596061; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Fixed-top navigation link; Ledger Gray at rest, ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-size: 14px; color: #596061; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f172a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Uppercase kicker above the hero name; the only tracked-caps pattern.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #596061; }

narrative.overview:
José Guilherme's portfolio is a quiet, precise record of professional work — a ledger kept in cool slate and paper. The palette reads like a well-organized codebase: near-white paper surfaces (#f9f9f9), a single near-black ink reserved for interaction (#0f172a), and cool grays carrying structure and hierarchy. Nothing flashes, nothing shouts; the interface behaves like well-documented code — everything in its place, each element earning its contrast.

The system is flat by default. Depth is conveyed through tonal layering — paper background, wash-tinted section bands, white cards — with a single restrained shadow level reserved for cards and imagery. Typography is one family, Inter, expressing hierarchy through size and weight alone. The strongest statement on the page is the photograph and the projects, not the chrome.

Anti-references (confirmed): this is not a dark-terminal aesthetic, and it is not a colorful agency showroom. Saturated accents, gradient text, and shadow-lifted buttons would break the world.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-on-paper contrast discipline: one near-black, one paper white, cool grays between
Single-family typography; hierarchy by size and weight only
Flat surfaces with tonal layering; one shadow level, sparingly used
Restrained motion: color-shift hovers (200–300ms), no lifts or transforms
Consistent focus treatment everywhere: 2px ring in Deep Slate Ink with 2px offset

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Deep Slate Ink appears on interactive elements and the JG mark only. Its rarity on an otherwise paper page is what makes it read as authority.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface. Hierarchy is expressed through size, weight, and case — never by adding a second family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows exist on cards and imagery only, never on interactive elements, and never intensify on hover.

rules.name: The One-Border Rule
rules.body: Borders exist only where they separate surfaces: the card edge, the footer top rule, and the mobile nav dropdown divider. Nav and hero carry no chrome.

dos: Do reserve Deep Slate Ink for interactive elements and the JG mark; everything else stays in the paper family.
Do keep surfaces within the paper family — Cool Paper, White Card, Ledger Wash.
Do use one shadow level (shadow-sm) on cards and imagery, and nowhere else.
Do use 6px radius for controls, 12px for cards, pills for chips.
Do express type hierarchy with size/weight — Inter only.
Do keep the uppercase tracking-wider eyebrow pattern for kickers.
Do apply the 2px ring focus treatment to every interactive element.
donts: Don't use saturated brand colors, gradients, or colorful accents — this is not an agency showroom.
Don't use dark backgrounds — the paper world is light by definition (anti-reference: dark-terminal aesthetic).
Don't lift buttons on hover or add shadow to interactive elements.
Don't add borders that don't separate surfaces.
